
tasks.subject: Task 5: Blended rerank in _apply_reranker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace pure-semantic overwrite with blend alpha*rerank + (1-alpha)*fused; alpha=1.0 reproduces today; reserved chunks never dropped.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/v1/retrieval.py", "tests/unit/test_blended_rerank.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_blended_rerank.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["alpha=0.6 => 0.6*rerank+0.4*fused", "alpha=1.0 reproduces overwrite", "no candidate dropped when pool<=top_k"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
